reason: The historical score inversion used FPw = S - TPw. The official metric defines FPw = S - Q, and the different maximization axes mean Q and TPw are generally unequal.

withdrawn_metrics.note: This is a direct count on the recorded SGMC public proxy after the stated filters; it is not an inferred private-label/live-truth count.

valid_residue: Direct measurements made on the named public SGMC proxy may be reproduced as conditional proxy measurements. They do not estimate private-label or live leaderboard performance; comparisons to the invalid per-dot threshold are withdrawn.
